source.note: Pilot and confirm are separate instance sets and are not pooled. A checker pass is not a complete cost ledger.

findings.note: A false admission is admission=true on the widest span and execution=false on the span the engine would fold. It is a deterministic span mismatch, not a model failure. The default-floor matrix measures the gap; the floor-sensitivity cases pin the verdict flip.

floorSensitivity.note: Each floor is set one token above the executed-span reclaim, so the widest span is still admitted while the span execution would fold is not. At the DEFAULT floors the large-span matrix clears both sides; this sensitivity shows the same gap flips the verdict when the span is near the floor.

spanEconomics.note: Deterministic keyless matrix. R2 live reports predate the probe, so exact-span data for those cells is unavailable, not zero.

probeAvailability.note: The R2 live reports were produced before the R3 telemetry. The probe is available for future runs and for the deterministic matrix.

stress.note: Not the shipped product preset: 16k window, retain 0.04, framing legacy, hint 400 effective despite 800 declared.

productPresets.note: The shipped presets use system-dedup framing, the tier retention and the tier hint budget. No R3 live cell ran them.

basic.dataStatus: observed in the stress lane only
basic.note: Native Basic is the B0 arm; its product defaults are not frozen by this report.

stressVsProduct.comparability: Stress-lane results must not be presented as product-preset evidence.

limits: The confirm is partial: 23 valid, 1 unresolved, 30 never-started. It is not a confirmatory result.
T14, T15 and T16 have no valid confirm cells; the valid subset is not a random sample of the 54-cell design.
Only 5 of 7 confirm B0/E1 pairs and 4 of 6 pilot pairs have complete usage on both sides.
The stress lane uses a 16k window, retain 0.04 and legacy framing; it is not the shipped economy/balanced/quality preset.
One model, one local route, one machine. No USD price is recorded or claimed.
R2 live reports predate the R3 leaf-span probe; exact-span economics for those cells is unavailable, not zero.
note: Descriptive paired deltas, not a powered economic estimate. The product lane has design only, no data.
